payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods and processes for building gazetteer resources from the Wikidata knowledge base, including the use of entity popularity filtering and the extraction of entity-type tuples.

claims.text: Gazetteer resources are built from the Wikidata knowledge base by processing official dumps into tuples of entity and type based on the instance_of triplet.
Entity popularity is used to filter ambiguous entities, retaining only the most popular types for each alias in the gazetteer.
The GazSelfAttn approach enhances gazetteer representation by using self-attention and match span encoding, which improves performance in named-entity recognition tasks.
